data.name: kiwibrowser/src.next
data.enhanced_text:
Source-code for Kiwi Next, a Kiwi Browser auto-rebased with latest Chromium.

Important note: Kiwi Browser is now archived. It will no longer be maintained after January 2025.
To support users who rely on extensions, we've partnered with the Microsoft Edge team to offer a smooth migration path.
Clicking the link will prompt you to install Microsoft Edge, reveal a hidden message in the Edge Extensions Hub, and uNBlock a powerful Manifest V2 extension there.
The extensions code for Kiwi Browser also has been integrated into the development version of Microsoft Edge: Microsoft Edge Canary.
To install extensions on Microsoft Edge Canary:
1. Open **Microsoft Edge Canary** and go to **Settings > About Microsoft Edge**.
2. Tap the **Edge build number** (e.g., ) 5 times to enable **Developer Options**.
3. In Developer Options, select **Extension install by id**.
